title: Johnathan Pagnutti - Wait, No, Hear Me Out: Simulating Encounter AI in Slay the Spire with SQL
speaker: Johnathan Pagnutti
talk_title: Wait, No, Hear Me Out: Simulating Encounter AI in Slay the Spire with SQL
description: Bring your best warding potions, safety sigils, and blessings: this talk is a light dip of some cursed queries to show how to simulate Slay the Spire's encounter AI with nothing more than SQL (and a lot of free time). Along the way, we'll go over some basic data structures for simulation, declarative vs imperative programming and how (with a little probability) even simple systems can lead to memorable, complex AI.
